# Rules

Every built-in rule, by category. Params go next to `rule` in a field's `rules`, and every rule also takes a `message`. A rule with params per kind lists them by kind.

## Length

| Rule | Label | Kinds | Params | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `length` | Exact length | string, array | `value`: integer, at least 0 |  |
| `minLength` | Minimum length | string, array | `value`: integer, at least 0 |  |
| `maxLength` | Maximum length | string, array | `value`: integer, at least 0 |  |
| `notLength` | Not this length | string, array | `value`: integer, at least 0 |  |

## Form rules

These go in `formRules`, next to `fields`. Each one also takes `field`, the path its error shows on, and `message`.

| Rule | Label | Kinds | Params | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `sameAs` | Same as | string, number, boolean, date | `other`: string | Equals another field, e.g. to confirm a password |
| `differentFrom` | Different from | string, number, boolean, date | `other`: string | Differs from another field, e.g. a new password |
| `compare` | Compare | number, date | `op`: "lt" \| "lte" \| "gt" \| "gte"; `other`: string | Less or greater than another field, e.g. an end date after the start |
